# app-store-server-library-python fixtures

- Repo: https://github.com/apple/app-store-server-library-python
- Commit: 1da04603e77b7da5b6a160d4ef8410ba2d2b70d4
- License: MIT (Copyright 2023 Apple Inc.)
- Path: `tests/resources/` . The same files are byte-identical in the node, java and swift sibling libraries
  (checked: testCA.der sha1 prefix 058397e0f20b, mock_signed_data/testNotification c06b0263a4bb).

## Trust root
The signed files chain to **a test CA (`certs/testCA.der`) generated by the Apple library authors, not to
Apple Root CA - G3**. To verify them use `apple.WithRootPool` with testCA.der, and pin the clock
(`WithTimeFn`) near 2023-04; they have 3-cert x5c chains with Apple's marker OIDs.
Checked on 2026-10-14: our `apple.Verifier` verifies testNotification, transactionInfo and renewalInfo
and wrongBundleId with that pool, rejects missingX5CHeaderClaim (`x5c must contain leaf and
intermediate, got 0 certs`) and legacyTransaction (`want 3 segments, got 1`).

## Files
| File | What |
|---|---|
| certs/testCA.der | test root |
| mock_signed_data/testNotification | JWS, payload `{notificationType TEST, signedDate 1681314324000, data{appAppleId 1234, bundleId com.example, environment Sandbox}}` |
| mock_signed_data/transactionInfo | JWS, `{environment Sandbox, bundleId com.example, signedDate 1672956154000}` |
| mock_signed_data/renewalInfo | JWS, `{environment Sandbox, signedDate 1672956154000}` |
| mock_signed_data/wrongBundleId | JWS TEST notification with data.bundleId com.example.wrong |
| mock_signed_data/missingX5CHeaderClaim | JWS whose header has `x5cwrong` instead of `x5c` |
| mock_signed_data/legacyTransaction | not a JWS (base64 legacy receipt plist) |
| models/signedNotification.json | DECODED payload: SUBSCRIBED/INITIAL_BUY (nested JWS are placeholder strings) |
| models/signedConsumptionRequestNotification.json | decoded CONSUMPTION_REQUEST |
| models/signedRescindConsentNotification.json | decoded RESCIND_CONSENT, uses top-level `appData`, no `data` |
| models/signedSummaryNotification.json | decoded RENEWAL_EXTENSION/SUMMARY, uses `summary`, no `data` |
| models/signedExternalPurchaseTokenNotification.json, ...SandboxNotification.json | decoded EXTERNAL_PURCHASE_TOKEN, uses `externalPurchaseToken`, no `data` |
| models/signedTransaction.json, signedTransactionWithRevocation.json, signedRenewalInfo.json | decoded transaction / renewal payloads (revocationDate, eligibleWinBackOfferIds, advancedCommerceInfo, ...) with `environment: LocalTesting` |
